$comment: Every piece of text GGDS writes itself, in English: the source for translations. {name} is filled in by the component; a placeholder may become a link or bold text, so keep every one in a translation. Django reads these through gettext (ggds_django/locale), React and Astro take a strings prop. Keys never change meaning: a new wording gets a new key.
